sections.heading: Sign-in returns to a session expired message in a loop
sections.text: A session expired loop during sign-in is usually caused by stale browser session data or several open tabs competing for the same session.

steps.text: Ask the user to clear cached data for the site and close all browser tabs for the platform.
Confirm the browser and version appear in the supported browser list in the system requirements article.
Ask the user to sign in again using a single browser tab.

information_needed.prompt: The date and time of the last sign-in attempt.

stop_conditions.text: If the loop continues after these steps, stop and escalate to L2 with the browser name, version, and attempt time.
Do not reset the user's password or change account settings to resolve this issue.
